_comment: Retrieval eval set for the coop-knowledge (design docs) RAG area.
Each item: a question a member could plausibly type, plus the section in the
corpus that actually answers it — so ground truth is objective, not a taste
judgement. Questions are PARAPHRASED on purpose: they must not reuse the
section's own distinctive wording, or the eval only measures keyword match.
doc = ground-truth document (file_name). section_key = a phrase that must
appear in a returned context's heading for a section-level hit (null for
generated HTML docs whose heading paths repeat).

items.q: what kind of account does an individual person get on the platform
can a member's phone act as a node in the network
how do automated browser tasks run and where does their evidence go
how can an agent or background service act for a member without holding their keys
how do one group's actions reach the groups connected to it
what can a member see and do with the files shared inside their group
how do survey forms map onto the platform's group and role model
what apps could a group's website embed and how would they authenticate
how is one group's data kept from another group's members
how do several people hold a secret that none of them can open alone
what was the state of the build at the last handoff note
how do you tell whether a declared service is actually running
what separates a brochure site from one members can work inside
what happens when someone signs in for the first time and is invited into a group
which farm management software is being integrated and under what licence
what licences are acceptable for the templates being brought into the marketplace
does the platform rely on a secure enclave or a third-party key service

where does the money sit at each step of the money map
